rules.title: Answer to Complaint
rules.description: Answer must be filed by Monday following expiration of 20 days after service of citation (Tex. R. Civ. P. 21a)
rules.text: A defendant must file an answer by the Monday following the expiration of 20 days after the defendant is served with citation.

rules.title: Motion to Dismiss
rules.description: Motion to dismiss for failure to state a claim (Tex. R. Civ. P. 91a.01)
rules.text: A party may move to dismiss a claim if it has no basis in law or fact.

rules.title: Discovery - Interrogatories
rules.description: Response to interrogatories must be served within 30 days (Tex. R. Civ. P. 202.3)
rules.text: Responses to interrogatories must be served within 30 days after being served.

rules.title: Notice of Deposition
rules.description: Notice of deposition must be served at least 10 days before deposition date (Tex. R. Civ. P. 199.1)
rules.text: A notice of deposition must be served at least 10 days before the scheduled deposition date.

localRules.title: Motion Practice
localRules.text: All motions must include a certificate of service and proposed order.
